name: RoboGuitar
tagline: A guitar whose chords are set by servos turning the tuning pegs, built from popsicle sticks and hot glue.
problem: Fretting chords is hard for people with small hands or cheap guitars.
solution: Servo motors controlled by a Raspberry Pi retune strings to produce chords instead of pressing frets.
demo_moment: Team-described: select a chord and hear the guitar retune itself.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Solo build that fuses music and engineering.

lessons: A scrappy physical build can win a solo prize on character alone.
